question: What chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes at this point?
premises: The colophon names the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
The chapter concerns the lower ten-tāla procedure.
inference: This concludes the fifty-eighth chapter on the lower ten-tāla procedure in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, on the procedure for the lower ten-tāla measure, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
